Welcome to the group, Anurag! 

If your partner is Jewish and making aliya, you can also make aliya with her if you are married. This saves you the hassle of going through the partner visa process which is long and cumbersome. Of course, I would never suggest anyone marry simply for paperwork; but if marriage is already on the cards, then it's worth considering joining your partner's aliya process instead of doing the partner visa process.

Also, we have a little WhatsApp group of Indian-Israeli couples. Feel free to join us!
